title: EaW/FoC LSP schema - enum file
description: Shape of eaw/enums/*.yaml and foc/enums/*.yaml. Mirrors YamlEnumFile/YamlEnumValueEntry.

name.description: Enum name as referenced by a tag's enumName. Should match the file name.

kind.description: Where the members come from. schemaFixed = listed here; dynamicXml = harvested from workspace XML; gameConstants = read from GameConstants.

isBitfield.description: True when members combine as flags rather than being mutually exclusive.

sourceFile.description: For dynamicXml enums, the game file the members are harvested from.

allOf.$comment: A schemaFixed enum lists its members here, so an empty or absent list means it validates nothing. dynamicXml and gameConstants enums harvest their members from game data at runtime and legitimately ship with no values at all.
A harvested enum needs to say where the members come from.

then.$comment: sourceFile is redeclared here only to satisfy ajv's strictRequired check.

note.description: One thing worth saying about this element, and what sort of thing it is. The kind decides the severity the editor shows and ranks the note against its siblings; it is not the note's order in this list.

kind.description: BuggedInEngine: accepted by the parser but does nothing, or the wrong thing - an error. Deprecated: worked once, something replaced it. Untested: believed correct, never verified against the shipped corpus. Remark: a caveat with nothing to act on. Since: the version this appeared in, carried in 'value'.

value.description: What the kind carries besides prose - the version, for Since.

notes.description: Everything worth saying about this element. Replaces the deprecated/untested/availableSince fields of schema 1.x.

name.description: Member name. UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for schemaFixed enums (including those that omit `kind`, which default to it) - one house style for the whole engine-fixed vocabulary, decided 2026-09-12. It is presentation only: every comparison against these sets is case-insensitive, so the shipped data's own mixed-case spellings (Laser, Standard, infantry) all still validate. dynamicXml and gameConstants enums are exempt, because their members ARE the data's spellings rather than an engine vocabulary.

params.description: Positional parameter slots, for story event/reward style members.
